title: Reheating
description: Inflation leaves space empty and cold. When the inflaton reaches the bottom of its potential it oscillates and decays, and its energy becomes a hot plasma of every particle there is: the hot Big Bang begins here. Unlocks Reheating Plasma.

puzzle.goal: At the end of inflation the inflaton decays at a rate λ, and its energy turns into a thermal bath of g relativistic species whose energy density is π²gT⁴/30. The decay completes when the expansion rate has fallen to the decay rate, with H² = ρ/(3M_P²). Write the temperature the universe is reheated to.
puzzle.name: Reheating temperature
puzzle.ask: With every Standard Model species in the bath (g = @{g}), a decay rate λ in GeV and M_P = M × 10¹⁸ GeV, find the reheating temperature in units of 10⁹ GeV.

vars.g: number of relativistic degrees of freedom

puzzle.method: Set H = λ, square it, replace H² by ρ/(3M_P²) and ρ by the radiation density, and solve for T.
